description: phiward: the guard on every tool call and the start-of-session note

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'command -v phiward >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "phiward is not installed or not on PATH: install it (step 1 of its quickstart), then start Claude Code again; every tool call is refused until then" >&2; exit 2; }; V=$(/usr/bin/awk "BEGIN{for(k in ENVIRON)if(k~/^(PYTHON|LD_|DYLD_|OPENSSL_|MALLOC_|Malloc)[A-Za-z0-9_]*\$/||k~/^(__PYVENV_LAUNCHER__|GCONV_PATH|LOCPATH|NLSPATH|GLIBC_TUNABLES|HOSTALIASES|LOCALDOMAIN|RES_OPTIONS|RESOLV_HOST_CONF|NIS_PATH|TZDIR|GETCONF_DIR)\$/||(k==\"TZ\"&&(ENVIRON[k]~/^:?\//||ENVIRON[k]~/\.\./)))printf \"%s \",k}") || { echo "phiward: /usr/bin/awk could not list the Python and loader variables to clear; every tool call is refused" >&2; exit 2; }; IFS=" "; unset $V; exec phiward hook claude'

/bin/sh -c 'command -v phiward >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "phiward is not installed: its guards refuse every tool call until it is; ask the operator"; exit 0; }; V=$(/usr/bin/awk "BEGIN{for(k in ENVIRON)if(k~/^(PYTHON|LD_|DYLD_|OPENSSL_|MALLOC_|Malloc)[A-Za-z0-9_]*\$/||k~/^(__PYVENV_LAUNCHER__|GCONV_PATH|LOCPATH|NLSPATH|GLIBC_TUNABLES|HOSTALIASES|LOCALDOMAIN|RES_OPTIONS|RESOLV_HOST_CONF|NIS_PATH|TZDIR|GETCONF_DIR)\$/||(k==\"TZ\"&&(ENVIRON[k]~/^:?\//||ENVIRON[k]~/\.\./)))printf \"%s \",k}") || { echo "phiward: /usr/bin/awk could not list the Python and loader variables to clear; every tool call is refused" >&2; exit 2; }; IFS=" "; unset $V; exec phiward session-note claude'
